config.label: Tracelane API key (tlane_…)
config.description: Tracelane API key (tlane_…). Resolved to a tenant once at startup via the gateway's /v1/auth/whoami; the server refuses to start if the key is rejected. Also the credential used to read trace data through the gateway when CLICKHOUSE_URL is unset.

config.label: Base URL of the Tracelane gateway
config.description: Base URL of the Tracelane gateway. Validates TRACELANE_API_KEY, and — when CLICKHOUSE_URL is unset — is where every trace read goes. Must be https://…tracelane.dev outside development.

config.label: self-host only; when unset the server reads through the gateway
config.description: self-host only; when unset the server reads through the gateway. Set this to point the server at your own ClickHouse instead of Tracelane Cloud.

config.label: ClickHouse database holding the spans table
config.description: ClickHouse database holding the spans table.

config.label: Transport to serve
config.description: Transport to serve. stdio (default) for desktop clients; http for the Streamable HTTP transport.
